meta.scope: Thailand Batch 5 — Education, poverty/living standards, and FTA network densification.

candidates.title: Education enrolment and attainment statistics
candidates.publisher: National Statistical Office / Ministry of Education related
candidates.description: Official statistics on enrolment rates by level and related attainment indicators. Primary enrolment is near-universal; secondary and tertiary participation form the main human-capital expansion margins.
candidates.notes: Core education access and human-capital node.

candidates.title: Poverty and living standards statistics
candidates.description: Official and compiled poverty rates and living-standards indicators. National poverty has declined to low single digits on some measures; upper-middle-income poverty lines still show residual double-digit shares, with regional disparities.

candidates.title: Thailand free trade agreement network framing
candidates.description: Overall framing of Thailand’s network of free trade agreements beyond ASEAN. Includes bilateral FTAs with Japan, Australia, New Zealand, India, Chile, Peru and plurilateral arrangements such as RCEP and ASEAN+1 frameworks. Continuously cited in trade-diversification and export analysis.
candidates.notes: System-level FTA architecture node complementing ASEAN membership.

candidates.title: Regional Comprehensive Economic Partnership (RCEP) framing
candidates.description: Framing of Thailand’s participation in RCEP, the largest regional trade agreement by population and GDP coverage. Complements ASEAN and bilateral FTAs in the Indo-Pacific preferential architecture.
candidates.notes: Major plurilateral densification of the external trade architecture.

candidates.title: Thailand education–poverty–FTA densification meta-node
candidates.publisher: Derived from NSO, commerce and development sources
candidates.description: Meta-node binding education enrolment statistics, poverty and living-standards indicators, FTA network framing and RCEP framing into a coherent human-capital, welfare and external-architecture layer.
